Where to look

  1. Tagvenue25 of our venues came from here. Prices usually include tax, and each room shows its refund deadline.Cheap party venues, Toronto ↗ Birthday venues, Toronto ↗ Cheap party venues, Brampton ↗
  2. Giggster13 of ours. Pick the 31-45 guest price tier. Fees and tax only appear at checkout, and the booking calendar allows up to 6 am even when the host doesn't.Party venues, Toronto ↗ Party venues, Brampton ↗
  3. Peerspace9 of ours. Set Dec 19, 8 pm-1:30 am to see the real total, then open each listing's Alcohol and AV tabs.Private parties, Toronto ↗
  4. Bars' own private-event pagesWhere the cheapest finds were: a flat fee, no minimum and no booking-site fee. Searching "[neighbourhood] bar private event flat fee" turns up more.Bluebird Bar ↗ Spice Lounge ↗ Tranzac ↗ Wenona ↗
  5. RedditLocals answering the same question: about 35 people, a friend's DJ gear, no community centres.r/askTO: spaces where I can bring a DJ deck ↗ r/mississauga: affordable birthday room ↗

Bars: the cost is the hire fee only, since guests pay for their own drinks; gratuity is added only where the listing states it. Private rooms: the room only; your alcohol, permit, insurance and supplies are extra. Giggster prices are base rent; its fees, tax and any cleaning fee show only during booking.

Sources: the venues' Tagvenue, Peerspace and Giggster listings and their own sites, read Nov 16-17, 2026. Photos are each listing's main image.
